question: Find an exact limiter MPN or manufacturer-supported controller-plus-external-limiter design for six independent 12 V loops with guaranteed 6.000-6.400 A full-tolerance/temperature current window and <=57 mOhm hot limiter allocation.

retention.disposition: manufacturer metadata, extracted facts and links only; no vendor PDF copied

sources.title: LTC4281 Hot Swap Controller with I2C Compatible Monitoring
limits: overcurrent-to-gate-low 0.5 us typ/1 us max under stated test
sources.gap: published threshold range plus shunt/temperature terms does not prove the 6.000-6.400 A window or <=57 mOhm hot path

sources.title: LTC4282 High Current Hot Swap Controller with I2C Compatible Monitoring
limits: two external N-channel FET gate circuits
sources.gap: complete threshold, hot resistance, calibration residual, fault and reverse qualification is not established by this packet

sources.title: 5.5V to 90V Advanced Hot Swap Controller with I/V/P Monitoring and PMBus Interface
sources.gap: current-threshold tolerance is incompatible with the 3.2258% total error budget

sources.title: LTC4218 Hot Swap Controller
sources.gap: 5% accuracy is wider than the total permitted error

sources.title: LTC4286 High Power Hot Swap Controller
sources.gap: accuracy is wider than the total permitted error

sources.title: MAX5977A high-side current-sense/gate-drive product record
sources.gap: no closed active 6 A current-limit, fault, reverse, or hot-resistance contract

sources.title: TPS24750 eFuse product record
sources.gap: verified full-temperature 6.000-6.400 A current-limit table and complete hot/fault/reverse evidence not retained

existing_negative_controls.reason: 5.7542457542-6.2462462462 A at recorded 6.25 kOhm setting; below 6.000 A floor

conclusion.closest_candidate_architecture: LTC4281 or LTC4282 plus Kelvin shunt, low-hot-resistance external nFET assembly, controlled calibration and production qualification
conclusion.recommendation: Product/Power Authority must qualify a calibrated assembly or request one further bounded search for a part with a guaranteed in-window threshold. Do not promote an MPN from this packet.
